$comment: Smaller repos shown on /archive. Curated by Claude for the owner (2026-10-16): only repos with real owner work and runnable code are shown; team work states the owner's part.

items.line: Word2Vec (CBOW and skip-gram) trained from scratch in PyTorch and with gensim on text scraped from IIT Jodhpur web pages, plus character-level name generation with RNN, BLSTM and attention models.
items.caution: Training names are synthetic syllable combinations, and the BLSTM sees future characters, so its near-zero loss is leakage. Do not quote its loss as a result.

items.line: Zero-shot comparison of SAM ViT-H, SAM ViT-B and MobileSAM on 10 COCO images: Dice, speed and encoder size.
items.context: Course project, team of 3 (pipeline, COCO integration and analysis were mine)
items.caution: n = 10. The README's LiTS numbers have no code in the repo, so leave them out.

items.line: BBC news sports-vs-politics classification comparing bag-of-words, TF-IDF and bigram features with Naive Bayes, logistic regression and linear SVM.
items.caution: Near-perfect accuracy reflects an easy task; no claims beyond the comparison.

items.line: C TCP server and client serving a menu of terminal games and equation solvers.
items.context: Course project, team of 4 (Maze Escape game, merging into one server-client, README were mine)

items.line: Text-based maze escape game in C with random obstacles, traps and seven levels.
